_comment: Canonical, locale-agnostic key contract for the quotation-builder-value-based engine. Keys here are STABLE identifiers used across every locale pack; locales map them to display prose but NEVER rename these ids. New countries add values with NAMESPACED ids (e.g. fr.chorus_pro) — see _namespacing. Derived from proposal_data.py (APP_DESCRIPTIONS), fill_spreadsheet.py (APP_TO_SHEET / APP_NAMES), generate_spreadsheet_template.py (APPS, SHEET_CATEGORIES, CAT_ORDER/CAT_NAMES), generate_proposal.py (APP_COLORS / APP_OUTCOME / APP_ICON_FILES, VA_EXCLUSIVO / VA_ADDONS / VA_POC, gantt phase codes, RECURRENT_DEFAULTS).

_namespacing.rule: Canonical ids are bare (e.g. 'crm'). A country-specific primitive not in the shared set is added with a locale-prefixed id: '<locale>.<id>' (e.g. 'fr.chorus_pro'). The validator accepts namespaced extras but rejects bare-key drift.

app_js_cond_map._comment: app_id -> the display literal the web-template JS compares against (appOn('CRM')/appOn('Proyecto')) and generate_proposal.py req_map. These are CONTROL-FLOW literals: for es they must stay byte-identical (BLOCKER B3). 'cond' fields in pricing.json reference the app_id, resolved to this literal at runtime.

js_cond_variants._comment: generate_proposal.py COND_VARIANTS — tolerant name matching, mirrors appOn() in the web template. Keyed by the js_cond literal.

processes._comment: End-to-end process taxonomy for the proposal's process view (P2P/O2C/R2R + residual). Canonical keys; es_display_name/es_tagline are the byte-frozen Spanish labels - locales translate via strings.sections.proc_<key>_name/_tag. Mapping rationale + literature (APQC PCF, SAP Signavio E2E, big-4 usage) in references/process_taxonomy.md. apps[*].process assigns each app to ONE process; changing the mapping = editing this JSON, never code. _order is the flow/render order (client-required header order: P2P, O2C, R2R, then the residual group).

p2p.es_tagline: De la compra al pago: aprovisionamiento, stock y producción

o2c.es_tagline: Del pedido al cobro: capta, vende, factura y atiende

r2r.es_tagline: Del registro al cierre: contabilidad y reporting

flows._comment: The Odoo Enterprise METRO MAP for the process view: the FULL network is always drawn; what the deal implements lights up (lit = in scope+selected, fase2 = in scope not preselected, ghost = Odoo has it, this proposal doesn't). Station slots: an app_id (resolves from the registry/locale catalog and can LIGHT UP), '~<ghost_id>' (curated Odoo Enterprise app NOT sellable as a line item here: entry in 'ghosts' below, icon from assets/odoo-icons, label via strings.sections.metro_app_<id>; always unlit, not clickable) or '@<milestone_id>' (process event; label via strings.sections.metro_ms_<id>). 'joins': the line flows INTO that app's station (mkt -> crm; crm renders as interchange). 'naming' = smart renaming for l2c (first LIT rule wins). A line is LIT iff >= 1 station is on. No prices on the map. Colors/geometry are engine constants; curation rationale in references/process_taxonomy.md (POS/Suscripciones/Alquiler/PLM and the productivity apps are deliberately left off to keep the map readable - add a ghost here + icon + 4 labels to extend).

categories._comment: Sheet categories from generate_spreadsheet_template.py SHEET_CATEGORIES. Keys are canonical; es_display_name is the current Spanish sheet label. A category with "vertical": true is OPT-IN: generate_spreadsheet_template.py NEVER emits its sheet in a plain template (no leak to the general base id=72/1); it only appears when the generator is called with --vertical <cat|app>, or when a sheet is seeded by hand (insert_vertical_sheet.py) into the construction base id=76 / a construction deal. Runtime resolution (generate_proposal / fill_spreadsheet) still treats these as first-class apps via app_registry.apps[*].

app_to_sheet_group._comment: fill_spreadsheet.py / generate_spreadsheet_template.py APP_TO_SHEET — which SHEET a marked app writes into. Since v4.19 the sheets GROUP BY END-TO-END PROCESS (language-neutral canon tab names: Order-to-Cash / Procure-to-Pay / Record-to-Report + People & support), consolidating the WP1 process view into the co-signed workbook. General Config and the vertical keep their own tabs. Tab names are ENGLISH in every locale (the group works in English internally); readers resolve the pre-v4.24 Spanish names by alias, see proposal_data / fill_spreadsheet.LEGACY_SHEET_ALIASES. LEGACY: workbooks created before v4.19 use the old category tabs (Comercial/Operaciones/Finanzas/Servicios/Web y Marketing/Otras) — fill_spreadsheet keeps a fallback map for them; the deployed base templates (ids 1/72/16/71) need a re-deploy to get process tabs.

func_categories._comment: Per-app catalog sub-category keys (generate_spreadsheet_template.py CAT_ORDER/CAT_NAMES). Keyed canonically; es_display_name = current sheet label. 'dynapps_core' is the group Core-module category (label varies per entity via instance.core_module_label).

phases._comment: Project/proposal phase codes. 'proposal_phases' = the 4 phases shown on the web/pdf proposal timeline (generate_proposal.py:711-714). 'gantt_phases' = the 5 codes used by the internal gantt/legend (generate_proposal.py:729-737). es labels are byte-frozen; locales translate via strings.json phases[*].label.

devs._comment: Custom-development ids. Derived from proposal_data.py DEV_DESCRIPTIONS. es_display_name = the exact key used today; description prose lives in the locale pack (strings/apps_catalog). Matching in proposal_data.py is accent-normalized + parenthetical-tolerant; dev_fallback used when no id matches.

complements._comment: Named app extras that carry cross-file semantics (detection signals, fiscal coupling, or standalone pricing). Derived from generate_spreadsheet_template.py APPS[*].extras and fiscal detection. Most spreadsheet extras stay inline in the sheet catalog; the ids listed here are the ones the plan (§2.2 pricing.complement_prices / fiscal.tax_filings) promotes to first-class join keys. es_display_name = current sheet extra label. fiscal:true means the complement is jurisdiction-specific and its copy/signals come from fiscal.json.

ia_products._comment: AI value-add catalog (generate_proposal.py VA_EXCLUSIVO / VA_ADDONS / VA_POC). product_id values are Odoo-DB-specific and MUST be verify_from_odoo per country (they are the es DB ids today). 'exclusive' = radio group (choose 1); 'addons' = multi-select. 'cond' references an app_id (resolved via app_js_cond_map).

starter_ia.es_display_name: Starter Pack IA — Formación e Infraestructura

recurrent_lines._comment: Recurring-cost line ids (proposal_data.py RECURRENT_DEFAULTS / RECURRENT_DESCS). id 'dyn_cloud' has display name 'Dyn Cloud' in code. Pre-rebrand, the ES spreadsheet cell emitted 'Indaws Cloud' on the live path -> desc lookup MISSED -> desc='' (B1, byte-frozen). Post-rebrand, Odoo emits 'Dyn Cloud' (== es_sheet_title below), so the lookup HITS and B1 is resolved. odoo_license is Odoo-SA-set -> verify_from_odoo.
